metadata.disclaimer: This application uses simulated infrastructure data based on public Mangaluru facility names. It is an educational prototype and not a validated disaster prediction or emergency decision-support system.
metadata.extensibility: Additional cities can be modeled by supplying structured JSON configuration files under data/.

assets.name: Kavoor 220/110 kV Substation (KPTCL)
assets.backup_protection: Standard grid circuit breakers; lacks perimeter flood berm and redundant dual river feeder.
assets.description: Primary transmission substation operated by KPTCL, supplying high-voltage electricity across northern and central Mangaluru, including the Netravati pumping stations, Wenlock Hospital, and Kadri telecom corridors.
assets.data_origin: Verified Public Facility Name (Model Dependencies Illustrative)

assets.name: Thumbay Vented Dam & Pumping Station
assets.service: Netravati River Potable Water Intake & Pressurization
assets.backup_protection: Automated hydraulic check valves; lacks on-site emergency diesel power generation.
assets.description: Primary municipal water intake on the Netravati River, pressurizing raw and treated water supply mains across Mangaluru City Corporation (MCC) limits.
assets.data_origin: Verified Public Facility Name (Model Dependencies Illustrative)

assets.name: Government Wenlock District Hospital
assets.service: Tertiary Trauma Care & Regional Emergency Healthcare
assets.backup_protection: Short-term uninterruptible power supply (UPS) batteries; lacks long-term microgrid and water storage reservoirs.
assets.description: Regional tertiary trauma care and multi-speciality government referral hospital in Hampankatta requiring continuous electrical power, pressurized water, telemetry communications, and road ambulance transit.
assets.data_origin: Verified Public Facility Name (Model Dependencies Illustrative)

assets.name: Kadri Hills Cellular & Microwave Relay Mast
assets.backup_protection: Standard cellular transceiver relay; vulnerable to power blackout and antenna shear from extreme coastal winds.
assets.description: High-elevation telecommunications antenna mast transmitting wireless voice, telemetry, and emergency dispatch radio for first responders across Mangaluru.
assets.data_origin: Verified Public Facility Name (Model Dependencies Illustrative)

assets.name: NH-66 Kulur Bridge Arterial Corridor
assets.service: National Highway Transit & Gurupura River Crossing
assets.backup_protection: Dual-lane arterial highway bridge corridor across river flood basin; lacks elevated flood bypass.
assets.description: Vital coastal highway bridge corridor carrying NH-66 traffic over the Gurupura River, connecting central Mangaluru to New Mangalore Port, industrial belts, and northern relief routes.
assets.data_origin: Verified Public Facility Name (Model Dependencies Illustrative)

assets.name: MCC Disaster Incident Command Centre
assets.backup_protection: Municipal dispatch facility; lacks auxiliary standby generator and redundant satellite dish link.
assets.description: Mangaluru City Corporation (MCC) emergency operations centre at Lalbagh coordinating ambulance, police, fire, and NDRF/SDRF coastal disaster response.
assets.data_origin: Verified Public Facility Name (Model Dependencies Illustrative)

assets.name: Baikampady Flood & Cyclone Evacuation Shelter
assets.backup_protection: Reinforced community evacuation hall; lacks dedicated potable water storage cistern.
assets.description: Designated public evacuation shelter in Baikampady accommodating coastal citizens and port-area workers displaced by Arabian Sea storm surges and river flooding.
assets.data_origin: Verified Public Facility Name (Model Dependencies Illustrative)

assets.name: Thumbay / Ramakrishna Mission Water Treatment Plant
assets.service: Netravati River Raw Water Purification & Disinfection
assets.backup_protection: Chlorination and rapid-sand filtration facility; trips offline immediately during electrical brownouts.
assets.description: Municipal purification station delivering potable treated water into Mangaluru City Corporation storage reservoirs.
assets.data_origin: Verified Public Facility Name (Model Dependencies Illustrative)

dependencies.description: Thumbay Water Pumping Station requires electrical power from Kavoor Substation to drive intake turbines.
Kadri Hills Communication Mast requires grid power from Kavoor Substation for cellular transmitters.
Government Wenlock Hospital requires electricity from Kavoor Substation for ICU, ventilators, and surgical suites.
Wenlock Hospital requires pressurized potable water from Thumbay Pumping Station for sterilization, dialysis, and hygiene.
Wenlock Hospital depends on Kadri Hills Communication Mast for ambulance telemetry, emergency dispatch, and telemedicine.
Wenlock Hospital requires NH-66 Kulur Corridor for patient ambulance arrivals, medical oxygen tankers, and trauma surgeons.
MCC Incident Command Centre requires electricity from Kavoor Substation to operate computer dispatch consoles and GIS servers.
MCC Incident Command Centre requires Kadri Hills Tower for 112 emergency calls and emergency responder radio channels.
MCC Incident Command Centre requires NH-66 Kulur Corridor for physical deployment of emergency rescue vehicles and fire tenders.
Baikampady Relief Shelter requires pressurized potable water from Thumbay Pumping Station to support evacuees.
Baikampady Relief Shelter requires NH-66 Kulur Corridor for evacuee transport and emergency food ration deliveries.
Thumbay Water Treatment Plant requires electricity from Kavoor Substation to run chemical pumps and filtration mixers.
Thumbay Water Treatment Plant requires raw water intake influx from Thumbay Pumping Station.

scenarios.name: Monsoon Cloudburst & Netravati / Gurupura River Flood
scenarios.description: Southwest monsoon cloudburst and Arabian Sea high-tide submerge low-lying switchgear at Kavoor Substation and wash out approaches to NH-66 Kulur Bridge.
scenarios.explanation: High water levels flood electrical switches at Kavoor Substation and breach the NH-66 Kulur Bridge corridor, simultaneously cutting power and physical transit across northern Mangaluru.

scenarios.name: Kavoor Substation Grid Transformer Failure
scenarios.description: Coastal salt-fog corrosion and intense lightning surge cause explosive transformer failure at Kavoor 220/110kV Substation, cutting off citywide grid power.
scenarios.explanation: Total blackout at Kavoor Substation severs electrical supply to water pumping, telecommunication towers, and healthcare lifelines.

scenarios.name: Severe Coastal Cyclone Telecommunications Collapse
scenarios.description: Severe Arabian Sea cyclone with 130 km/h wind gusts shears microwave dish arrays at Kadri Hills Tower and snaps aerial fiber-optic connections.
scenarios.explanation: Complete loss of wireless communications and telemetry across Mangaluru City Corporation emergency dispatch and hospital networks.

interventions.name: Kavoor Substation Flood Berms & Sump Pumps
interventions.description: Constructs reinforced concrete perimeter flood berms and automated submersible dewatering pumps around Kavoor Substation switchgear.
interventions.estimated_benefit: Prevents floodwaters from inundating Kavoor Substation during extreme Netravati and Gurupura river overflows.

interventions.name: NH-66 Kulur Corridor Elevated Bypass
interventions.description: Builds an all-weather elevated bypass causeway and reinforced riprap embankments along the Gurupura river crossing.
interventions.estimated_benefit: Ensures uninterrupted ambulance transit to Wenlock Hospital and Baikampady relief shelters during river flooding.

interventions.name: Thumbay Pumping Station Diesel Backup Microgrid
interventions.description: Installs an on-site diesel backup generator and automatic transfer switch (ATS) at the Thumbay Water Pumping Station.
interventions.estimated_benefit: Maintains municipal water pumping operations during power outages, preserving potable supplies to Wenlock Hospital and shelters.

interventions.name: Kadri Tower Wind Hardening & Battery Array
interventions.description: Equips Kadri Hills Mast with high-tensile guy-wire storm rigging and long-duration lithium battery backup banks.
interventions.estimated_benefit: Maintains telecom operations through power outages and resists cyclone wind shear up to 150 km/h.

interventions.name: Wenlock Hospital Autonomous Microgrid & Water Tanks
interventions.description: Installs dedicated hospital emergency diesel microgrid and on-site dual 20,000-liter hygienic potable water cisterns.
interventions.estimated_benefit: Protects Wenlock Hospital operations against loss of municipal electricity and municipal water supplies.

interventions.name: MCC Command Centre Satellite Terminal & Generator
interventions.description: Provides auxiliary generator backup and satellite communication link for continuous 112 / 108 emergency dispatch.
interventions.estimated_benefit: Keeps MCC emergency dispatch and responder coordination active through municipal power and tower outages.
